segmentation.text: Whenever an illuminated flashing red or yellow signal is used in conjunction with an official traffic-control device,
it shall require obedience by vehicular traffic as follows:
When a red lens is illuminated with rapid intermittent flashes,
shall stop before entering the nearest crosswalk in an intersection or at a limit line when marked, or, if none, then before entering the intersection,
and the right to proceed shall be subject to the rules applicable after making a required stop.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal carries the states flashing_red and flashing_yellow of 'a signal head'; an illuminated flashing signal used as an official device is such a head present in the scene; its official status is read from its presence.

'Vehicular traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic limited to its vehicle members, the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, as the index maps 'Such vehicular traffic' (NRS_484B_307_5a_o2).

A red lens with rapid intermittent flashes is dev.traffic_signal state flashing_red. It applies to the subject where the head governs (dev.governs) the carrier c (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies) and enters intersection i through (st.lane_enters), or governs i itself.
Reuses the index mapping of 'drivers of vehicles,' (NRS_484B_307_12a): the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; the driver role is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

Reuses the index mapping of the parallel stop-before words (NRS_484B_307_8a_o1, NRS_484A_450_2). A stop is drv.motion.complete_halt ('complete cessation from movement', DEF-NRS-484A-255). The limit line is st.stop_line ('the transverse line marking where vehicles halt for a device'); the nearest crosswalk in the intersection is the st.crosswalk recorded as marking the subject's carrier's entrance (st.entrance_of, 'exactly that carrier's entrance'; the carrier enters i, st.lane_enters). The side of a mark is read along the carrier's direction (st.lane_direction, prim.region_offset_along); the distance through st.region_geometry; a halt overlapping the mark or i (rel.occupies) is not before entering it.

residues.why: The words subject the right to proceed after the stop to 'the rules applicable after making a required stop' without naming any rule of the corpus; this node judges the stop, and the proceeding is judged by those rules on their own terms.

applicability: The subject is vehicular traffic (ru.aggregate traffic and vehicle). Judged at the observation at which the subject enters an intersection i (its footprint comes to overlap i, not having overlapped it at the previous observation) from a carrier c entering i (st.lane_enters) that it occupied at the previous observation, while a traffic signal head governing c or i (dev.governs) displays flashing_red at that entry observation.
obligation: Act before an event (the ontology's approach convention). Event: the subject's entry into i through c. Place: where a stop line or a crosswalk is recorded as marking c's entrance (st.entrance_of), a halt (drv.motion.complete_halt with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance) with the subject's body within p.stop_point_tolerance of such a mark (st.region_geometry), short of it along c's designated direction (sign of prim.region_offset_along along st.lane_direction) and not overlapping it nor i (rel.occupies); the crosswalk and the limit line are alternatives, and a halt at either discharges; where the marks' entrance lists are observed and neither a crosswalk nor a stop line marks c, a halt within p.stop_point_tolerance of i's edge at c's entrance end, not overlapping i. History bound: the search runs back from the entry and ends only at the approach start (the last observation before the entry at which the subject, on a carrier the mark marks, is outside the mark's stopping zone upstream: off it, short of it and farther from it than p.stop_point_tolerance; for several marks, outside the zone of each and short of each) or at the subject's previous entry into i; never at the recording's start or a distance travelled. A halt found discharges; either end reached without one violates; reaching neither is unknown. The entry is unknown where the observation before it is missing or does not place the subject on a mapped carrier; where a mark's association with c is unobserved, whether it governs is unknown, and the verdict is unknown only where it depends on it.

narrowings.why: 'before entering the nearest crosswalk ... or at a limit line when marked' is read as two alternative places, each marking the subject's approach carrier: a halt within the stop-point tolerance short of either discharges; 'if none' is read where the source's complete entrance lists show neither marks the carrier.
The official status of the flashing signal is read through the head's presence in the scene.
'drivers' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever is at the controls.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car occupies approach lane c entering i; a stop line is recorded as marking c; the head governing c displays flashing_red. The car approaches from beyond the stopping zone and enters i without a halt (speed stays above the tolerance).

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the car halts with its body within the tolerance short of the stop line, not overlapping it, then enters i.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The head governing c displays circular_green when the car enters i.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the head's state is not observed at the entry (dev.traffic_signal absent).

scenarios.name: history_boundary
scenarios.narrative: The recording begins with the car already within the stop line's stopping zone on c, rolling slowly under a flashing red; it enters i. No halt is recorded and no earlier entry into i is recorded.
scenarios.boundary: the car's approach to the stop line on c before the recording began, where a halt may have been made

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The source's entrance lists show no stop line and no crosswalk marking c; the car halts with its body within the tolerance of i's edge, not overlapping i, then enters under flashing red.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of automotive perception and simulator scene-graph sources

param_proposals.name: p.stop_point_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the body-to-mark gap within which a halt counts as at the mark: a stop line's set-back before a crossing plus a placement margin
param_proposals.source: MUTCD stop line placement (4 ft before the crosswalk) plus a placement margin
